{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the current state
print(f'Original dataset shape: {penguins.shape}')
print(f'Missing values in flipper_length_mm: {penguins["flipper_length_mm"].isnull().sum()}')
print(f'Missing values in body_mass_g: {penguins["body_mass_g"].isnull().sum()}')

# Impute missing values in flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g with their respective means
mean_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
mean_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Fill missing values
penguins_imputed = penguins.copy()
penguins_imputed['flipper_length_mm'].fillna(mean_flipper, inplace=True)
penguins_imputed['body_mass_g'].fillna(mean_body_mass, inplace=True)

# Verify no missing values remain
print(f'Missing values after imputation: {penguins_imputed["flipper_length_mm"].isnull().sum()}, {penguins_imputed["body_mass_g"].isnull().sum()}')

# Compute Pearson correlation on the full dataset with imputed values
correlation_imputed = penguins_imputed['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_imputed['body_mass_g'])

# Print result
print(f'Pearson correlation with mean imputation: {correlation_imputed}')"}
